name: Oath-Keeper
symbol: a scale balanced by a sword
clergy: the Oath-Sept, minor septs of the Crownlands that tend the law without Solvane's grandeur
temperament: stern, precise, bound by the letter
attitude_to_magic: Magic is a breach of the quietus; Oath-Keeper's clerks are the only ones licensed to witness certified cantrips for royal disputes.

worship_by_species.name: Oath-Keeper
worship_by_species.note: Crownlands septs officiate minor royal betrothals and land disputes; the Reeve's court tolerates but does not endorse.

worship_by_species.name: rejected
worship_by_species.note: The deep-folk have their own hold-marshal; they recognize no power above the Hold-voice.

worship_by_species.name: the-Second-Silence
worship_by_species.note: The greenfolk name the quiet between the seasons; Oath-Keeper is that pause, not the great Solvane.

worship_by_species.name: the-Binding-Still
worship_by_species.note: The desert's still places between dunes are his domain; travelers who linger too long under his gaze find their oaths magically enforced.
